title: CAN+CACHE+CM · RAG, 32k stable corpus + 1k query
summary: serialization + boundary, not either alone
action: A sends serialized corpus each call; B canonicalizes bytes, sets one explicit stable-prefix boundary, sends query unchanged.
measurement: Capture M1,M2 under the shared recipe scorecard.
caveat: C1,C2; E-OA-CACHE,E-OA-COUNT

title: CACHE+STABLE+CM · agent, tools + variable history
summary: config stability interaction
action: A changes effort/tool config between turns; B fixes both inside same cached session and varies only user tail.
measurement: Capture M1,M2,M3 under the shared recipe scorecard.
caveat: C1,C2; E-OA-CACHE

title: CACHE+TTL+CM · long chat
summary: explicit write control + TTL
action: A implicit cache; B explicit 30-minute boundary on policy/tools only, with uncached tail.
measurement: Capture M1,M2 under the shared recipe scorecard.
caveat: C1,C2; E-OA-CACHE

title: CAN+CACHE+MEDIA · multimodal RAG
summary: asset identity plus cache, not generic prefix
action: A resends 20MB PDF; B canonicalizes immutable asset ID and caches asset before new questions.
measurement: Capture M1,M2,M7 under the shared recipe scorecard.
caveat: C1,C2,C3; E-OA-CACHE

title: CACHE+RET · support classification
summary: retrieval changes input shape while cache preserves policy
action: A injects full 100k FAQ; B retrieves top 8 chunks under the stable policy prefix.
measurement: Capture M1,M2,M10 under the shared recipe scorecard.
caveat: C2,C3,C8; E-OA-CACHE,E-OA-RET

title: CACHE(moving)+CM · growing chat
summary: moving-prefix state, not generic caching
action: A rewrites all history; B top-level ephemeral cache on every turn and appends one new tail.
measurement: Capture M1,M2 under the shared recipe scorecard.
caveat: C1,C2; E-AN-CACHE

title: CACHE(4 breaks)+TOOLS+CM · tool agent
summary: hierarchy interaction
action: A one breakpoint after full transcript; B breaks tools/policy/corpus/anchor separately, ≤4 slots.
measurement: Capture M1,M2,M6 under the shared recipe scorecard.
caveat: C1,C2; E-AN-CACHE,E-AN-TOOLS

title: CACHE(anchor)+TOOLS · tool-heavy chat
summary: lookback constraint, not another cache key
action: A leaves 25+ blocks between writes; B consolidates tool blocks and places anchor within 20 blocks.
measurement: Capture M1,M2,M6 under the shared recipe scorecard.
caveat: C1,C2; E-AN-CACHE

title: CACHE+TTL+RET · RAG
summary: empirically selected TTL
action: A 5m cache on corpus; B chooses 1h only when inter-arrival p90 exceeds 5m.
measurement: Capture M1,M2,M10 under the shared recipe scorecard.
caveat: C1,C2,C8; E-AN-CACHE

title: WARM+CACHE · agent
summary: concurrency/warm-up interaction
action: A parallel fan-out starts cold; B one warm request completes cache then releases 20 parallel calls.
measurement: Capture M1,M2,M5 under the shared recipe scorecard.
caveat: C2,C4; E-AN-CACHE

title: STABLE+CACHE · agent
summary: stable config plus cache state
action: A changes effort/thinking on each turn; B keeps config constant through a cached session, then tests a new session.
measurement: Capture M1,M2,M3 under the shared recipe scorecard.
caveat: C1,C2; E-AN-CACHE

title: CACHE+MEDIA · PDF QA
summary: document reuse, not text-only cache
action: A uploads PDF on every question; B caches user-turn document and sends only question tail.
measurement: Capture M1,M2,M7 under the shared recipe scorecard.
caveat: C1,C2,C3; E-AN-CACHE

title: CACHE(named)+TTL · legal RAG
summary: explicit object economics
action: A sends corpus inline; B creates named CachedContent once, references it for 30 questions, then deletes/records expiry.
measurement: Capture M1,M2,M10 under the shared recipe scorecard.
caveat: C1,C2; E-GG-CACHE

title: CACHE(implicit)+CAN · chat
summary: implicit cache diagnostic, not guarantee
